name: Mystique 1
description: Invocateur ouvrant des portails vers les dimensions chthoniennes permettant le passage d'entités alliées depuis d'autres mondes.

subject.archetype: Mystique 1 — Éveil Chthonien Uncommon class faille_dimensionnelle

loadout.armor_outfit: Ancient ceremonial armor fused to wearer's body through dark ritual, shadowy fabric etched with independently shifting runic patterns casting purple light, living shadow tendrils writhing from shoulder guards with own consciousness, armor plates absorbing light instead of reflecting creating void patches
loadout.arsenal: Massive ritual staff taller than wielder inscribed with independently rotating forbidden symbols, shadow-manipulation artifact orbiting hand like dark satellite with void energy tendrils connecting to body, cursed amulets chained to armor pulsating with green phosphor light emitting foul energy wisps The weapon and gauntlets actively channel the character's growing ability targeting adjacent_friendly, visible energy conduits linking weapon to body with flowing power

attitude.behavior: Combat specialist engaged in the heat of battle with weapon and body fully committed to the fight. One arm extended powerfully toward ally with focused targeted green energy streaming from palm in thick flowing ribbon connecting to ally's body with visible strengthening effect
attitude.emotion: Battle-tested confidence — knowing skills will carry through the engagement

style.rendering_style: cinematic action photography with gritty realism, motion blur on projectiles and debris, sharp focus on character face and primary weapon, high contrast lighting with dramatic deep shadows

color_and_light.lighting_setup: oxidized copper frame with faction insignia embossed on each corner, explosive backlight from ability discharge, dramatic rim lighting separating character from environmental chaos, volumetric light rays cutting through smoke and particles

camera.angle: Slightly low angle waist-up shot with environmental action visible in background, motion blur on debris and effects

scenography.setting: Torn dimensional battlefield with ground splitting open in massive fissures as enormous shadow tentacles erupt from below, sky showing impossible geometry and wrongness human mind cannot process, ancient runes blazing on every surface as dimensions collapse, reality thinning and tearing at edges, thick oppressive atmosphere of supernatural dread
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Powerful energy bridge arcing between caster's hand and target with secondary sparks jumping off main channel to nearby allies creating chain reaction of empowerment, Ground beneath allies glowing green where energy arrives, visible strengthening wave passing through each connected unit, terrain responding to positive energy with new growth, Massive shadow tentacles erupting from cracked ground grasping at sky, dimensional rifts tearing open revealing impossible non-Euclidean geometry with wrong colors, floating forbidden runes spinning violently in dark purple energy maelstrom, skeletal remains rattling and rising from earth, void essence fog rolling across ground like creeping tsunami
